product_from_film: ChatGPT Atlas is a browser with page-aware assistance, inline writing help, browsing memory and an agent that prepares shopping carts.
explains_well: The shopping example shows a request, a Continue confirmation, visible browsing steps and a cart ready for checkout.
unclear: The email-shortening example ends before a clearly readable revised draft, so its before-and-after is incomplete.
scenario: Ask about a rental and flight, revise an email, reopen past pages and prepare beach supplies in a cart.
product_clear_basis: The named app opens a browser and navigates to a travel site by 14s; the page-aware sidebar appears at 23s.

categories.finding: The silent workflow is largely readable through requests, chapter cards and visible outputs; email revision is the weak payoff.
The page stays left and the request/answer right; later reframing focuses the cart and checkout boundary.
Several brief examples establish range, then shopping gets a longer request-to-result sequence.
The promise of web assistance pays off in a prepared cart and recovered tabs.
Familiar tasks and a controlled confirmation step suggest convenience and user control; response unmeasured.
Consistent page-context chips connect each question to its current page. Shopping items remain traceable into the cart.
The film shows selected answers, tab recovery and cart states, not verified answer accuracy, memory scope, reliable automation or a completed purchase.
